name: dynamic-drop-zone
title: Dynamic Drop Zone
description: A file drop zone that turns into a magnetic black hole.
docs:
Dynamic Drop Zone — A file drop zone that turns into a magnetic black hole.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Be Vietnam Pro (400 to 600). If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.

While it is mounted, a file dropped anywhere on the page outside the zone is kept from opening in the browser. The upload itself is a timed animation: read the files from `onDrop` and send them wherever they need to go.
